headline: 演出評論二三事
context: 表演這邊有兩則評論。搖滾樂團Evanescence在里茲演出，主唱艾米·李（Amy Lee）飆到破表的高音技驚全場；倫敦南華克劇院上演的音樂劇《簡愛》，卡司唱功不錯，但角色刻劃偏薄弱，比較像迪士尼式浪漫，少了維多利亞哥德風的黑暗感。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: First Direct Arena, Leeds The titanic choruses and stormy metal riffs of latest album Sanctuary are the perfect foundation for Amy Lee’s astonishing, skyscraping vocal range To watch Evanescence in concert is to be spellbound by founder Amy Lee’s astonishing voice. The Arkansas band’s gifted mezzo-soprano lends their music vocals that range from skyscraping and spectacular to haunting and devastating. She soon moves through the registers on the opener Sanctuary, setting the stage for a show during which her vocals seem to scale ever greater peaks, even when you are convinced that there are no octaves left to conquer. And she makes it look effortless, striding around the stage, headbanging and fist-pumping the air. It’s standard promotional protocol for a band to lean on their new album on tour, but it still shows impressive faith in their audience that tonight Evanescence perform all but one song from Sanctuary, which is also the title of their sixth LP. Jordan Fish, formerly of Bring Me the Horizon, produced most of it and his metallic influence is clear: pummelling drums, titanic choruses and walls of stormy riffs make the band’s new material noticeably heavier than the gothic hard rock of their earlier years. sources.summary: Southwark Playhouse Elephant, London This production has a talented cast and looks the part, but the characterisation is thin and the songs are often cloying Much like Emerald Fennell’s film of Wuthering Heights , this musical version of another Brontë sister’s literary masterpiece is lovely to look at. Designer Morgan Large’s monochrome palette fashions the women in black corseted dresses with attractive ruffles and delicate mesh detailing. Behind them on a screen, a mist appears to roll over sketches of moorland, graves and barren trees. It’s winningly atmospheric. But also like Fennell’s film, there’s too little beneath the frills in an adaptation (music and lyrics by Paul Gordon, book and additional lyrics by John Caird) that struggles to tap into the substance of Charlotte Brontë’s 1847 novel. Though smart-mouthed and bolshie as a child (played commendably on press night by Emily-Rose Samuel), there’s scant sense of a strong-willed, independent thinker in Charlie Burn’s adult Jane, who under Caird and Megan McGinnis’s direction is as pure and polite as a fairytale princess. Nor is there anything dark or dangerous about Ashley Gilmour’s courteous, too-charming Rochester. At Southwark Playhouse Elephant, London , until 24 October Continue reading...

thread_text:
演出評論二三事

先看搖滾。Evanescence在里茲的演出，主唱艾米·李（Amy Lee）的高音技驚全場，新專輯《Sanctuary》的厚重金屬riff和滔滔大合唱，是這場演出的最佳基底。

再看劇場。倫敦南華克劇院的音樂劇《簡愛》，卡司唱功到位、場景也很有氣氛，但角色刻劃偏薄弱，少了原著該有的維多利亞哥德式黑暗感，更像一齣迪士尼式的浪漫劇。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 9 月 9 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
演出評論二三事

先看搖滾演唱會。Evanescence在里茲First Direct Arena的演出，主唱艾米·李（Amy Lee）的女中音一路飆到讓人屏息的高音，新專輯《Sanctuary》裡厚重的金屬riff和滔滔大合唱，撐起整場演出的氣勢——而且他們幾乎唱完整張新專輯，對觀眾的信任感相當夠。

再看劇場。倫敦南華克劇院上演的音樂劇《簡愛》，卡司唱功到位，場景設計也很有氣氛，黑白色調搭配蕾絲細節，畫面很美。但可惜角色刻劃偏薄弱，主角少了原著裡那種倔強獨立的個性，更像一齣迪士尼式的浪漫劇，少了維多利亞哥德風該有的黑暗感。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 9 月 9 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 表演這邊，今天有兩則評論。先是搖滾天團Evanescence的演唱會，主唱艾米·李的高音技驚全場，新專輯裡厚重的riff和大合唱，撐起整場氣勢。換個場景，來看劇場——倫敦有一齣音樂劇版的《簡愛》，卡司唱功不錯，但角色刻劃偏薄弱，少了原著該有的黑暗感，反而更像一齣迪士尼式的浪漫劇。
